chapter: Black Benny, brass bands and bass drum
title: Black Benny with the Sam Morgan band
summary: He recalls Black Benny's bass drum playing in the Sam Morgan band.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Yes. Yeah, he was with Sam Morgan Band and I, I couldn't tell you too much, about too many of the fellas in the band. I could call three guys I know of sure, four I'd say. Sam Morgan, Gaillet, playing trombone, Alfred William drums. And if I'm not mistaken, I think Paul Vaughn was playing clarinet with him. I'm not too chill on that. It's been so long, you know. I really believe that he was playing, I just admire Black Benny's bass drum playing.
What sort of raps would he make on the bass drum?
Well, you saw it on the style of this guy, with his son, a few clothes, about his height, but he's just about his style of playing. It's about the same.
